reason: The 10 MB upload limit is hardcoded in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js:182 and app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js:246 (`10 * 1024`), as well as on the server in app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb:55 (`10.megabytes`) and config/nginx.sample.conf:61 (`client_max_body_size 10m`).
